bead.title: Add kind Helm integration harness
bead.description:
Add the reusable kind-based Helm integration harness. This bead builds or loads the pqueue container image, creates a disposable kind cluster, installs the Helm chart with a selected backend profile, waits for readiness, runs a smoke check, and cleans up by default.

The script must support at least:
- `--backend postgres_native`
- `--backend object_log_sqlite_projection`
- `--dry-run` to print the planned commands/values without creating a cluster
- `--help`

In-scope files:
- scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh
- scripts/ci/kind/** helper manifests or values files
- charts/pqueue/** only for values needed by the harness
- docs/** for local prerequisites
Out-of-scope:
- Proving each backend end-to-end; separate beads run the harness for each backend and fix backend-specific issues.
bead.acceptance:
1. `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --help` exits 0 and documents required tools.
2. `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend postgres_native --dry-run` exits 0.
3. `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend object_log_sqlite_projection --dry-run` exits 0.
4. The script checks for required tools (`docker`, `kind`, `kubectl`, `helm`) and exits with a clear message when one is missing.
